title: [grug] Skip unused tail masks in the ragged expert MLP
body:
Remove the three tail masks from the QuACK expert MLP on the ragged all-to-all EP path: the forward output, the output gradient, and the input gradient. Each mask was a full pass over the receiver buffer. The grouped GEMMs bound their reads by the segment boundaries, and the return transport sends only active rows, so unused rows never reach the combine. The input-gradient tail flows only into the cotangent of the integer-built dispatch buffer, which JAX discards. The local/FSDP expert MLP reads its whole buffer in the combine and keeps its masks. The transport round-trip tests now fill unused receiver capacity with NaN, and the SM100 kernel test pads its inputs with NaN rows.

On 64 GB200 GPUs, removing the masks improves mean training throughput by 1.76% and full-iteration throughput by 1.77%. Each arm ran three times on the same rack, restoring the permanent hero `2026.08.19.2/checkpoints/step-30000` checkpoint with the production data mixture, batch 1024, sequence length 4096, and one process per GPU. Each run discards 20 warmup updates and scores all 60 updates from 30020 through 30079. The control is #9366, which this PR is stacked on; without that fix, GPU gangs launched from `main` can fail NCCL bootstrap.

| Configuration | Mean step time | Mean iteration time | MFU | Runs |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Control | 14.176 s | 14.411 s | 27.69% | [a](https://wandb.ai/marin-community/marin_moe/runs/ep-maskab-control-a-20260922), [b](https://wandb.ai/marin-community/marin_moe/runs/ep-maskab-control-b-20260922), [c](https://wandb.ai/marin-community/marin_moe/runs/ep-maskab-control-c-20260922) |
| Tail masks removed | 13.932 s | 14.161 s | 28.18% | [a](https://wandb.ai/marin-community/marin_moe/runs/ep-maskab-mask-a-20260922), [b](https://wandb.ai/marin-community/marin_moe/runs/ep-maskab-mask-b-20260922), [c](https://wandb.ai/marin-community/marin_moe/runs/ep-maskab-mask-c-20260922) |

Paired gains were 2.01%, 1.62%, and 1.64%. Losses stayed finite, and the largest matched-step loss difference from a control run was 0.00067, against 0.00045 between control repetitions. The runs cover one rack and exclude the hero's inter-rack collectives.

Replaces #9315. That PR also registered NCCL symmetric buffers for all-gather and reduce-scatter; #9374 defers that change because it adds only 0.32% on top of this one and has not been tested at hero scale across racks or with interleaved evaluation.
